WHY THIS EVENT. The distance-to-centerline column is the cross-track
coordinate of each chord, already reduced by the authors, so the sky-plane
geometry needs no ephemeris, no station projection and no Earth rotation on
this bench. And the campaign published its NEGATIVE stations with their
distances, which is what bounds the body from outside.
The chord LENGTH is invariant under the timing shifts the paper debates
(Table 6, "original" versus "shifted" chords): a shift moves a chord along
its own line and does not change how long it is. So this analysis does not
depend on which of the two fits one prefers.
